The upper section of the backrest features a woven fabric insert, likely made of a natural material such as jute or burlap, which adds texture to the design. The lower section of the backrest is also made of wood, matching the rest of the chair's frame. The seat of the chair is upholstered with a similar woven fabric, providing comfort and a cohesive look with the backrest.
